name: Meridian Incident Command Platform
description: A premium single-page Tailwind CSS template for an incident command platform built for on-call engineering teams. Neo-Industrial utility language meets Swiss Minimal discipline — 1px hairline rules, graph-paper blueprint surfaces, Space Grotesk display type, JetBrains Mono metadata, a hand-built incident command-surface hero with a live latency sparkline and floating signal/escalation cards, a directed alert-routing graph visualization, a five-step incident lifecycle workflow, dark customer-outcome metrics, engineer testimonials, per-on-call-team pricing, a scoped single-open FAQ accordion, and a dark corner-tick conversion CTA.
features: editorial-technical split hero with incident command-surface product visualization (live status, latency sparkline, responders, timeline, runbook footer)
floating signal-correlation + stepped-escalation mini-cards layered around the hero panel
signature directed alert-routing graph (signal → correlate → rule → page) with animated edges and an ack-fallback branch
five-step incident lifecycle workflow with per-step timings and a signed-state rail
dark customer-outcome metrics band (MTTA / MTTR / noise / burnout) on a divided grid
featured pull-quote testimonial + secondary engineer testimonial cards
three-tier per-on-call-team pricing with featured Squad plan
scoped single-open FAQ accordion (CSS-grid animation, ARIA, keyboard)
dark conversion CTA with corner-tick framing and a three-line onboarding panel
five-column footer with live system-status indicator
sticky navbar with scoped vanilla-JS mobile menu (escape-safe)
consistent Neo-Industrial + Swiss Minimal token system: 1px hairlines, square radii, single amber accent, blueprint graph-paper surfaces, restrained tonal elevation
semantic HTML, skip link, ARIA, visible focus states, and prefers-reduced-motion support
Tailwind CSS via CDN with no build step
